about.title: About me
about.description: As a passionate Frontend Developer, I enjoy transforming creative ideas into modern, user-friendly, and functional web applications. What excites me most is combining appealing design, intuitive user experiences, and clean, well-structured code. I work with modern web technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Angular, and I continuously expand my knowledge and technical skills. I focus on responsive design, performance, and accessibility to create digital experiences that work seamlessly across devices. I approach new challenges with an analytical mindset, a structured workflow, and a solution-oriented attitude. Creativity, persistence, and a strong willingness to learn are among my key strengths. I also value collaboration and teamwork, as I believe great software is built through shared ideas, constructive feedback, and continuous improvement. My goal is to bring my passion for frontend development to a professional team, keep growing as a developer, and actively help build innovative digital solutions.

general.title: 1. General Information
general.text:
Protecting your personal data is important to me. In this Privacy Policy, I explain what personal data is processed when you visit my portfolio website, for what purposes this is done, and what rights you have.

This website serves as a personal showcase of my skills, projects, and experience in the field of front-end development, as well as a means of establishing contact regarding professional opportunities.

Personal data refers to any information that can be used to identify a natural person, either directly or indirectly.

controller.title: 2. Data Controller
controller.text:
The data controller for this website is:

Selim Özbek
Frankfurter Straße 75
51065 Cologne
Germany

Email: s.oezbek@soz-studio.de

hosting.title: 3. Website Hosting and Provision
hosting.text:
When you visit this website, technically necessary data is transferred between your browser and the web server. This may include, in particular, your IP address.

This data is processed to make the website available, detect technical errors, and ensure the security and stability of the service.

The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) of the GDPR. My legitimate interest lies in the secure and reliable operation of my portfolio website.

Hosting provider: [To be added prior to publication]

To the extent that the hosting provider processes personal data on my behalf, the necessary data protection agreements will be entered into.

logs.title: 4. Server Log Files
logs.text:
When you visit the website, the hosting provider may generate server log files. These may contain, for example, the following information:

• IP address
• Date and time of access
• Pages and files accessed
• Browser type and version
• Operating system
• Referrer URL
• Technical status and error messages

To the extent that such logs are collected, this is done to ensure technical operation, for error analysis, and to prevent unauthorized access, based on Article 6(1)(f) of the GDPR.

The actual logging and retention periods depend on the hosting provider’s settings and must be specified prior to publication.

contact.title: 5. Contact
contact.text:
You can reach me using the contact information provided on this website.

If you send me an email, I will process the data you provide—in particular your email address, the content of the message, and, if applicable, your name—solely for the purpose of handling your inquiry and for further communication.

The legal basis is generally Article 6(1)(f) of the GDPR. To the extent that the communication serves to carry out pre-contractual measures in response to your inquiry, Article 6(1)(b) of the GDPR may apply.

The contact form displayed on the website is not currently activated for actually sending messages. In the current implementation, form submissions are not forwarded to a backend service.

storage.title: 6. Local Storage and Cookies
storage.text:
My website stores the language setting you have selected (German or English) locally in your browser. The web storage technology localStorage is used for this purpose.

This storage serves to retain your language setting for future visits. The language preference can be removed via your browser settings or by clearing your browser’s website data.

The requirements of Section 25 of the TDDDG apply to accessing or storing information on your device. Consent is not required, among other cases, if the storage in question is absolutely necessary for the provision of an expressly requested service.

Whether cookies or other storage technologies are used by the hosting provider or by additional integrated services must be verified prior to publication.

external.title: 7. External Links
external.text:
This website contains links to external platforms and project pages, such as GitHub or live demonstrations of my projects.

Simply displaying a standard external link does not establish a connection to its destination page. If you click on such a link, the privacy policy of the respective provider applies.

The respective operators of external websites are responsible for the processing of personal data on those sites.

retention.title: 8. Retention Period and Deletion
retention.text:
Personal data is stored only for as long as necessary for the respective processing purposes or as required by statutory retention obligations.

Data from personal contact requests is deleted as soon as processing is complete and there are no legal or other legitimate reasons for further retention.

Specific retention periods for server log files must be supplemented in accordance with the actual settings of the hosting provider.

rights.title: 9. Your Data Protection Rights
rights.text:
Within the framework of the legal requirements, you are entitled to the following rights in particular:

• Right of Access (Art. 15 GDPR): You may request information regarding the processing of your personal data.
• Rectification (Art. 16 GDPR): You may request the correction of inaccurate data.
• Erasure (Art. 17 GDPR): Under certain conditions, you may request the erasure of your data.
• Restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR): You may request a restriction of processing under certain conditions.
• Data portability (Art. 20 GDPR): You may, subject to the legal requirements, receive the data you have provided in a suitable format.
• Objection (Art. 21 GDPR): You may object to data processing under the conditions set forth by law.

If processing is based on your consent, you may revoke it at any time with future effect.

To exercise your rights, you can contact me by email at s.oezbek@soz-studio.de.

authority.title: 10. Right to File a Complaint with a Supervisory Authority
authority.text:
You have the right to file a complaint with a competent data protection supervisory authority if you believe that the processing of your personal data violates applicable data protection law.

For North Rhine-Westphalia, the State Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information of North Rhine-Westphalia (LDI NRW) is the competent supervisory authority.

security.title: 11. Data Security
security.text:
I place a high priority on the protection of personal data and implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures.

When the website is made publicly available, an encrypted HTTPS connection should be used. The specific security measures implemented also depend on the hosting provider used.

changes.title: 12. Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.text:
I reserve the right to amend this Privacy Policy if legal requirements or the technical functionality of my website change.

This applies in particular to the future activation of the contact form or the integration of additional services.
